tools.name: tiktok_hashtag_details

tools.name: tiktok_hashtag_videos

tools.name: tiktok_music_details

tools.name: tiktok_music_videos

tools.name: tiktok_playlist_details

tools.name: tiktok_playlist_videos

tools.name: facebook_page_details

tools.name: facebook_page_posts

tools.name: facebook_page_photos

tools.name: facebook_page_reels

tools.name: facebook_page_reviews

tools.name: facebook_group_details

tools.name: facebook_group_posts

tools.name: facebook_post_comments

tools.name: search_facebook_pages

tools.name: search_facebook_events

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_twitter" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Twitter/X posts by keyword; X search operators work in query. Returns tweet text, author username, URL, date and engagement metrics (likes, retweets, replies, views). Filter by time window (posted_ago) or date range. Use twitter_user_tweets for one account's timeline. Billed $0.006 per page." → after: "Search Twitter/X posts by keyword; X search operators work in query. Returns tweet text, author username, URL, date, engagement metrics (likes, retweets, replies, views) and X's "Made with AI" label (ai_label). Filter by time window (posted_ago) or date range. Use twitter_user_tweets for one account"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
